decisions.reason: As a close extension in a growing market with organisational slack, Product A likely meets aspirations, so the probability of withdrawal remains low.
Product B remains close to the established offer and its results compare favourably with aspirations, so it is kept.
Product C is another close-to-core condenser and, absent a shortfall, slack allows retention with low withdrawal probability.
Product E's customized air cooler line extends the core offer and benefits from slack, so it is retained.
Product F is an incremental service extension and, given slack and no evidence of shortfall, is kept.
